address: 15 quai de la Poissonnerie, Colmar, 68000, France
bio: Head down to the docks of Little Venice for a fine dining experience, courtesy of Le Quai 21 and its deftly-crafted score in the zeitgeist. Examples include tartlet of prawns with samphire and spicy coconut milk, or skate wing from Brittany flanked by a risotto of spelt with razor clams and snails and a chorizo cream. Smart fashionable interior....
